description:
HTTP sources over Spring RestClient. Nothing in the base standalone server or
    Spring Boot starter compiles against this module: the configuration-driven
    JSON REST mode it implements is a separately reviewed adapter extension,
    loaded only by an operator who opts in, over the same
    -Dloader.path=<reviewed extension jar> mechanism task 17 built for any
    other reviewed adapter. That is what keeps the MCP layer unable to reach a
    source directly by default.
